_doc: Häxkittelns effekter som recept (shared/effects/vfx.js, docs/effektlabb.md, E6): spakarna per slag, grupperade i kort, och färdiga effekter. Texten som visas är på engelska. Sparade effekter hamnar i assets/vfx/<namn>.vfx.json ({ name, kind, settings }). Formatera med tools/vfx/write_vfx.py.

kinds.label: Glow & aura
kinds.help: Glowing rims, light pillars and auras around figures and objects

params.label: Colour
params.help: The glow at the feet and along the rim

params.label: Top colour
params.help: The glow towards the head; the aura fades from Colour to this

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright the rim glows (above 1 it blooms)

params.label: Rim sharpness
params.help: High: only a thin edge glows. Low: the whole figure glows

params.label: Shell offset
params.help: How far outside the figure the glowing shell sits (m)

params.label: Inner fill
params.help: Glow over the whole figure, not just the rim

params.label: Flicker
params.help: Noise that breaks the glow into rising flames

params.label: Flicker size
params.help: Small values: big slow tongues. Large values: fine sparkle

params.label: Flow speed
params.help: How fast the flicker rises (m/s)

params.label: Pulse
params.help: How much the whole aura breathes

params.label: Pulse speed
params.help: Pulses per second

params.label: Strength
params.help: A column of light around the figure; 0 = none

params.label: Radius
params.help: The column's radius (m)

params.label: Height
params.help: The column's height (m)

params.label: Ground glow
params.help: A bright pool on the ground under the figure

params.label: Ground radius
params.help: The size of the pool (m)

params.label: Light
params.help: A point light in the aura's colour that lights the surroundings

params.label: Light flicker
params.help: Makes the light waver, like fire

params.label: Count
params.help: Sparks rising around the figure; 0 = none

params.label: Size
params.help: The size of a spark (m)

params.label: Rise speed
params.help: How fast they rise (m/s)

params.label: Swirl
params.help: How fast they circle the figure (negative: the other way)

kinds.label: Markers
kinds.help: Selection rings, targets, ability areas and exclamation marks, projected onto the ground

params.label: Shape
params.help: Selection ring: under the selected unit. Target: an aim with ticks. Area: an ability's area with runes and a cast timer. Exclamation: a quest sign over the head

params.label: Radius
params.help: The marker's size on the ground (m). It is projected onto the ground and follows slopes

params.label: Ring width
params.help: The ring's width (m)

params.label: Dashes
params.help: Breaks the ring into dashes; 0 = solid

params.label: Dash length
params.help: How much of each dash is drawn

params.label: Sign size
params.help: The exclamation mark's height (m)

params.label: Colour
params.help: The ring and the lines

params.label: Inner colour
params.help: The fill inside the ring, and the sign's outline

params.label: Inner fill
params.help: How much the inside is filled

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: Sharp or soft edges

params.label: Glow
params.help: Brightness; above 1 it blooms

params.label: Additive
params.help: Light that adds to the ground (on) or paint that covers it (off)

params.label: Spin
params.help: Rotation of dashes and ticks (radians per second)

params.label: Pulse
params.help: Size and brightness that breathe

params.label: Pulse speed
params.help: Pulses per second

params.label: Ripples
params.help: Rings that run across the marker; 0 = none

params.label: Ripple speed
params.help: Positive: outward. Negative: inward, like "move here"

params.label: Cast time
params.help: Area: fills from the centre over this many seconds and starts again; 0 = off

params.label: Sign bob
params.help: How much the exclamation mark bobs (m)

kinds.label: Particles
kinds.help: Sparks, fire, smoke, magic, leaves and dust: particle systems on the graphics card

params.label: Mode
params.help: Continuous: a steady stream. Burst: everything at once when you press Play (or every few seconds with Loop)

params.label: Count
params.help: How many particles live at the same time (continuous) or in one burst

params.label: Lifetime
params.help: How long a particle lives (s)

params.label: Lifetime spread
params.help: Some particles die sooner

params.label: Burst length
params.help: Burst: spreads the births over this many seconds

params.label: Emitter
params.help: Where the particles are born

params.label: Emitter size
params.help: The radius of the sphere, disc or ring (m)

params.label: Speed
params.help: Start speed (m/s)

params.label: Speed spread
params.help: Some particles start slower

params.label: Cone angle
params.help: Spread around straight up (degrees); 180 = every direction

params.label: Outward
params.help: Extra speed out from the emitter's centre (negative: inward)

params.label: Gravity
params.help: Pulls down (m/s²); negative values make them rise, like smoke and fire

params.label: Drag
params.help: Air resistance: the particles slow down

params.label: Swirl
params.help: Turns around the emitter (radians per second)

params.label: Turbulence
params.help: Wobble along the way (m)

params.label: Wind
params.help: How much the wind carries them (the Wind slider under View)

params.label: Sprite
params.help: The particle's shape

params.label: Additive
params.help: Light that adds up (fire, magic, sparks) or paint that covers (smoke, dust, leaves)

params.label: Size at birth
params.help: Size when born (m)

params.label: Size at death
params.help: Size when it dies (m)

params.label: Size spread
params.help: Some particles are smaller

params.label: Stretch
params.help: Stretches the sprite along its motion, for streaks; 0 = round and spinning

params.label: Spin
params.help: How fast the sprites turn (radians per second)

params.label: Colour at birth
params.help: Colour when born

params.label: Colour mid-life
params.help: Colour halfway

params.label: Colour at death
params.help: Colour when it dies

params.label: Opacity
params.help: How opaque

params.label: Fade in
params.help: Share of the life spent fading in

params.label: Fade out
params.help: Share of the life spent fading out

params.label: Glow
params.help: Brightness; above 1 it blooms

params.label: Flicker
params.help: Each particle twinkles

kinds.label: Trails & hits
kinds.help: Sword trails, projectiles with tails, and hits

params.label: Mode
params.help: Sword swing: a ribbon behind the blade. Projectile: a shot from the figure to the dummy, with a tail and a hit

params.label: Length
params.help: How long the trail stays (s)

params.label: Blade cover
params.help: Sword: how much of the blade leaves a trail, from the tip

params.label: Tail width
params.help: Projectile: the tail's width (m)

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: How softly the trail fades towards its edges

params.label: Head colour
params.help: The fresh end of the trail

params.label: Tail colour
params.help: The old end of the trail

params.label: Glow
params.help: Brightness; above 1 it blooms. Near 0 it is paint instead of light

params.label: Swings per second
params.help: Sword: how often it swings

params.label: Arc
params.help: Sword: how wide the swing is (degrees)

params.label: Tilt
params.help: Sword: tilts the swing from flat to diagonal (degrees)

params.label: Speed
params.help: Projectile: speed (m/s)

params.label: Arc height
params.help: Projectile: how high the path bows (m)

params.label: Head size
params.help: Projectile: the glowing head's size (m)

params.label: Tail sparks
params.help: Projectile: sparks shed along the way

params.label: Shot interval
params.help: Projectile: seconds between shots when looping

params.label: Hit colour
params.help: The hit's sparks, ring and flash

params.label: Sparks
params.help: Sparks thrown out by the hit

params.label: Spark speed
params.help: How fast the sparks fly (m/s)

params.label: Shock ring
params.help: The expanding ring's radius (m); 0 = none

params.label: Flash
params.help: A short flash of light
